entries.subject: top-level input and output regions
entries.condition: Pointers are four-byte aligned, lengths are within 256 KiB, contained in fixed memory, and regions do not overlap.
entries.limitation: Memory outside ABI and validator work regions is module-private.

entries.subject: nested payload containment and aliasing
entries.condition: Every non-empty payload is claimed inside the input region before it is read and cannot overlap an earlier claim.
entries.limitation: A hostile host that concurrently changes memory during evaluate is outside the ABI model.

entries.subject: UTF-8 and canonical empty descriptors
entries.condition: String bytes are valid scalar UTF-8 and empty String/List descriptors use pointer zero.
entries.limitation: Normalization of valid Unicode scalar sequences is not performed.

entries.subject: List and aggregate limits
entries.condition: Each List has at most 4096 elements and aggregate List elements do not exceed 16384.
entries.limitation: Limits are ABI resource policy rather than general-purpose allocation limits.

entries.subject: arena allocation
entries.condition: Alignment padding and size are compared with remaining capacity before heap mutation.
entries.limitation: The arena remains evaluation-scoped and is not a public allocator.

entries.subject: copy bounds
entries.condition: Source and destination ranges are checked against current memory before byte copies.
entries.limitation: Typed scalar stores rely on validated layouts and safe arena addresses.

entries.subject: host value shape and canonical encoding
entries.condition: Only exact plain-object shapes, i32 values, bounded Lists, and scalar strings are encoded.
positive: runtime evaluate with canonical JavaScript input
entries.limitation: This layer does not replace generated-Wasm validation for direct callers.

entries.subject: fault stop and instance lifetime
entries.condition: Validation and resource failures trap with the first fault and leave busy set.
positive: fresh instance after a failed invocation
entries.limitation: Runtime creates a fresh instance for every public evaluate call.

entries.subject: RegionMemory metadata
entries.condition: Release deletes allocation metadata, IDs are never reused, and ID exhaustion fails closed.
positive: 1000000 allocate/release cycles with one free block
entries.limitation: RegionMemory is independent from the Collection Wasm arena.

entries.subject: linear-memory bounds
entries.condition: The module has fixed 128-page memory and cannot grow it.
entries.limitation: Engine bounds do not establish descriptor semantics without generated validators.
